basis: On the public Q1 earnings call, CFO Jonathan Ramsden gave both components of the fiscal Q2 2021 sales outlook. Big Lots expected a low-double-digit year-over-year comparable-sales decline, offset by approximately 150 basis points from net new and remodeled stores. At the least severe double-digit decline of 10%, the implied high end for total sales growth was approximately −8.5% (−10% + 1.5 percentage points), below the −5% threshold. This is a derived, approximate high end. The issuer explicitly tied both components to the target quarter.

coverage.detail: The March 5 fiscal Q4 2020 release gave a fiscal Q1 2021 outlook and withheld full-year guidance. It supplied no fiscal Q2 sales bound.
On the March 5 call, management described Q2 and Q3 comparisons as challenging. Its quantified sales outlook applied to Q1.

The May 28 Q1 release forecast a low-double-digit Q2 comparable-sales decline and roughly 20% two-year stacked comparable-sales growth. The release alone did not quantify the contribution from stores outside the comparable base.

On page 8 of the May 28 call transcript, Ramsden quantified the offset to the Q2 comparable-sales decline as approximately 150 basis points. That supplied the missing contribution needed to evaluate total sales.
Item 2.02 identifies May 28 as the date of the release and call and describes the guidance as initial fiscal Q2 2021 guidance.

Searches for intervening preliminary results, guidance updates, presentations and public conference remarks through August 26 located no revised Q2 sales outlook. Item 2.02 identifies the August 27 release, call and accompanying investor presentation as Q2 results materials.

The August 27 consolidated statements report net sales of $1,457,374,000 for the 13 weeks ended July 31, 2021 and $1,644,197,000 for the 13 weeks ended August 1, 2020. Actual sales fell 11.4% and were below the $1,561,987,150 cutoff. The prior-year distribution-center sale gain appears separately below gross margin.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s EX-99.2 dates the public earnings call May 28, 2021. The operator announced a replay beginning at noon Eastern that same day. Item 2.02 of the June 1 Form 8-K independently confirms that Big Lots conducted the call and gave its initial Q2 guidance on May 28.
